pages.text: Opens your persistent vault and adds its secrets to your vault.

Without $(1)password$(), your game asks you for it; after a wrong one, you can try again. A wrong $(1)password$() raises WRONG_PASSWORD. Without a persistent vault, the function raises VAULT_NOT_FOUND. An open vault stays open until you leave.
$(li)$(1)password$() STRING: the password (optional, default: ask the player)$(li)no results
